tools.name: read_formula
tools.description: One LaTeX formula in (math mode, no dollar signs). Back come what it reads as, the words a screen reader says for it, the text it copies out as, and its MathML. Free without a key, thirty formulas every ten minutes; with a key, a tenth of a cent each.

tools.name: count_project
tools.description: A LaTeX project in. Its pages, formulas, figures and tables out, with what each tool would cost for it, in cents. Free, with a key. Up to 24 MB for the project. A project that cannot be built costs nothing; the answer gives the file and line.
